name: Jan de Vries
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport began in his youth, fueled by a passion for tinkering with engines. He started his career in local karting, quickly gaining a reputation for his meticulous approach to setup and problem-solving. This led to opportunities in Formula Ford and eventually the junior ranks of single-seater racing. Jan is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to clearly communicate complex technical information to drivers. 

He's worked with a diverse range of drivers, adapting his engineering style to suit individual needs. Jan believes a collaborative environment is key to success, emphasizing open communication and mutual respect within the team. His experience in various racing disciplines has equipped him with a broad understanding of vehicle dynamics and setup optimization, making him a valuable asset to Prema Junior. Jan is particularly adept at analyzing telemetry data to identify areas for improvement and extract maximum performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze, Jan looks like he's perpetually calculating something.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook for jotting down observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Dutch licorice in the garage at all times.
